rubrics.justification: Accurately reflects the provided Gardner 2BB grading and gives a reasonable general interpretation, but relies mostly on the lab grade rather than image-specific morphology and adds limited direct visual detail.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometriosis, prior outcomes, sperm motility, BMI, and thin endometrium well with embryo quality and prognosis; only minor overemphasis on some lifestyle factors.

Overall logic is clear and consistent, especially linking young age and fair embryo quality against thin endometrium and endometriosis; minor issues include calling BMI 25.7 fully healthy/normal and some speculative treatment effects.

Mostly consistent with standard IVF principles on embryo grading, age effects, and thin endometrium concerns, but includes several adjuncts with limited evidence or not routinely guideline-endorsed (sildenafil, aspirin, PRP, G-CSF, scratch, ERA in this context).

Provides clear next-step recommendations for current transfer and future planning, including endometrial evaluation and endometriosis management, though some suggestions are not strongly evidence-based and should be framed more cautiously.
